CreateOrder.description: A JSON object containing order creation information for a tenant or an organization. The `transactionId` and `externalPartnerId` format must be alphanumeric and can include dashes and underscores. `externalPartnerId` lengths cannot exceed 64 characters. Organization `name` length cannot exceed 128 characters. Append the '-TST' SKU suffix when sending test orders for MES. Append the '-TRL' SKU suffix when sending trial orders for MES. If your create request contains a SKU that has a 'U1M' or is a 'UC' SKU for 1 Month `autoRenewState` must be set = 'ON'.

ModifyOrder.description: A JSON object containing one or more order modifications for an existing tenant. The `external_partner_id` must match an existing tenant. The `transaction_id` and `external_partner_id` format must be alphanumeric and can include dashes and underscores. Append the '-TST' SKU suffix when sending test orders for MES. Append the '-TRL' SKU suffix when sending trial orders for MES. If your modify request contains a SKU that has a 'U1M' or is a 'UC' SKU for 1 Month `autoRenewState` must be set = 'ON'.

RenewOrder.description: The `external_partner_id` must match an existing tenant. The `transaction_id` and `external_partner_id` format must be alphanumeric and can include dashes and underscores. Append the '-TST' SKU suffix when sending test orders for MES. Append the '-TRL' SKU suffix when sending trial orders for MES. If your renew request contains a SKU that has a 'U1M' or is a 'UC' SKU for 1 Month `autoRenewState` must be set = 'ON'.

CancelOrder.description: The `external_partner_id` must match an existing tenant. The `transaction_id` and `external_partner_id` format must be alphanumeric and can include dashes and underscores.
